identify: Thrips are very small brown or black insects with narrow fringed wings.
Heavy attack makes the leaf tissue look silver.
damage: The thrips feed on the sheath of the flag leaf, the stem and the heads.

cultural: Use blue sticky traps for thrips at 4-5 traps/acre.
Collect and destroy the diseased and insect infected plant parts.
biological: Protect predatory mites, predatory thrips and hover flies in the field.
